title: scope OBSERVABILITY.md to generated target-project code — stop per-ticket relitigation in reviews (human ruling 2026-07-07)
description: Human ruling at the 2026-07-07 Gate 5 checkpoint (option: scope to generated projects). Context: .claude/shared/OBSERVABILITY.md mandates OTel spans, but the hivemind repo itself carries zero OpenTelemetry dependencies or instrumentation anywhere, and the standard references manifests (SCREEN_SPECS.md, BLOCK_TASKS.md) that exist only in the vendored Spine skill flow for scaffolded target projects. Three consecutive reviewers (rev-103, rev-104, rev-105) independently flagged and then hand-waived the mismatch as a repo-wide standing deviation. Fix is documentation: state the standard's scope explicitly so reviewers stop relitigating it per ticket.
acceptance_criteria: OBSERVABILITY.md gains an explicit scope statement: it governs code the framework GENERATES for target projects (the impl-* manifest/code-writer flow), NOT the framework's own repo, whose observability convention is structured JSON result envelopes + typed errors with codes.
The reviewer guidance (agents/reviewer.md + parity copy, or wherever the observability gate is invoked) references the scope so the per-ticket judgment is mechanical.
UAT: read the amended standard and one reviewer-guidance site; confirm the scope is unambiguous.

comments.author: uat
comments.body:
UAT for TASK-112 (documentation; uat-only). All steps verified by Orchestrator at the human's request (standing uat_delegated_to_orchestrator grant). Implementation commit 5449371.

Step 1 (AC1) — OBSERVABILITY.md gains an explicit scope statement: governs code the framework GENERATES for target projects, NOT the framework's own repo (whose convention is structured JSON result envelopes + typed errors with codes).
  Expected: a prominent scope section stating the OTel mandate applies to the generated-target-project flow (impl-*/code-writer/code-reviewer) and not to hivemind's own src/bin/agents, naming the framework's actual convention.
  Observed: .claude/shared/OBSERVABILITY.md adds a '## Scope' section immediately after the H1 (before any other content). It states the standard governs 'code the framework generates for target projects', explicitly 'does not govern the hivemind framework's own repo' (zero OTel deps), and names the own-repo convention 'structured JSON result envelopes + typed errors with codes' with concrete examples ({ ok: false, error } returns, Error subclasses setting this.code). Convention claim independently confirmed TRUE against real src/ code (close-guard.js LOOP_UAT_COMMENT_DENIED, task-store.js E_DANGLING_DEPENDS_ON, brain-client.js { ok:false } envelope).
  Verdict: PASS

Step 2 (AC2) — Reviewer guidance references the scope so the per-ticket judgment is mechanical.
  Expected: the reviewer's observability gate points at the Scope section so a reviewer can classify any diff at a glance.
  Observed: agents/reviewer.md (+ byte-identical .claude/agents copy) observability bullet changed to 'BLOCK, scoped' — instructs 'Check the doc's Scope section first', states the OTel requirements apply only to the impl-* generated flow, and for framework-own-repo diffs to NOT raise an OTel finding but instead confirm typed .code errors + structured JSON. Judgment is now mechanical.
  Verdict: PASS

Step 3 (AC3) — Read the amended standard + one reviewer-guidance site; confirm the scope is unambiguous.
  Expected: the two sites read together leave no ambiguity about which diffs the standard applies to.
  Observed: read OBSERVABILITY.md Scope section + agents/reviewer.md observability bullet. Both name the exact in-scope flow (impl-*/code-writer/code-reviewer) and exact out-of-scope target (hivemind's own src/bin/agents) with the concrete alternative convention. Unambiguous — stops the per-ticket relitigation the three prior reviewers (rev-103/104/105) engaged in.
  Verdict: PASS

Overall result: PASS (3/3). Existing doc-lock tests/spine-standards-docs.spec.js extended (red-green planted); no second OBSERVABILITY.md copy exists; no bundled code touched; fast tier 996 passed / 2 skip.
